inputs.history: the vault's own on-chain decision events before this decision
inputs.price: close of the last closed daily candle (Binance NEARUSDT 1d); the spot reference price is recorded but not read

rule: Random trades under the same limits: each tick, with probability 0.25, buy or sell 10-50% of the remaining cap (per trade and rolling 24 h). The randomness is sha256(seed|vault|seq|slot block hash): the vault's own decision number and the hash of the first block at or after the scheduled slot, which nobody knows earlier.
